title: GameClipRecord
description: Task A structured record: content stance (4-class) + P/R codebook tags for one short game video.

one_liner.description: One sentence: what this clip is and what makes it work.

label.description: Content stance (4-class). mixed = positive and negative structure co-present/reversed within the clip; intensity alone is NOT mixed.

evidence.description: Must point to concrete frames/seconds (e.g. 'f_04 第一滴血, f_16 二连击破').

p_codes.description: Plot-layer codes (multi-select). Each entry must carry frame/second evidence. May be empty ONLY if no code in the codebook fits.

r_codes_hit.description: Visual-feature codes (R1-R9) that the clip demonstrably shows.
